title: Bookmark - Data API
description: Represents a link between opportunities that share common information.

ID.description: ID of the bookmark. Label is Bookmark ID.

FromId.description: The originating opportunity. Label is Bookmarked From ID

ToId.description: The opportunity to which the originating opportunity is linked. Label is Bookmarked To ID.

IsDeleted.description: Indicates whether the object has been moved to the Recycle Bin (true) or not (false). Label is Deleted.

usage:
The Bookmark object works with the Opportunity object only. Use this read-only object to query the bookmarks between opportunities in your organization. In the online application, users can search for opportunities that share attributes with their opportunity. The user can then bookmark the appropriate opportunities for future reference.
